title: The Volterra Stein-Stein model with stochastic interest rates
abstract: arXiv:2503.01716v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We introduce the Volterra Stein-Stein model with stochastic interest rates, where both volatility and interest rates are driven by correlated Gaussian Volterra processes. This framework unifies various well-known Markovian and non-Markovian models while preserving analytical tractability for pricing and hedging financial derivatives. We derive explicit formulas for pricing zero-coupon bond and interest rate cap or floor, along with a semi-explicit expression for the characteristic function of the log-forward index using Fredholm resolvents and determinants. This allows for fast and efficient derivative pricing and calibration via Fourier methods. translated_title: 具有随机利率的Volterra Stein-Stein模型
translated_abstract: 我们引入了具有随机利率的Volterra Stein-Stein模型，其中波动率和利率均由相关的Gaussian Volterra过程驱动。该框架统一了多种著名的马尔可夫和非马尔可夫模型，同时保持了金融衍生品定价与对冲的解析可处理性。我们推导了零息债券和利率上限/下限期权的显式定价公式，并利用Fredholm预解式和行列式得到了对数远期指数特征函数的半显式表达式。这使得通过傅里叶方法可以快速高效地进行衍生品定价和校准。我们将模型校准至市场数据，并观察到该框架足够灵活，能够捕捉关键的经验特征，例如利率上限期权ATM隐含波动率的驼峰形期限结构，以及（在对数-对数尺度下）凹形的ATM隐含波动率偏斜期限结构。
tldr: 本文提出了波动率和利率均由相关Gaussian Volterra过程驱动的Volterra Stein-Stein模型，在统一多种马尔可夫和非马尔可夫模型的同时，通过显式和半显式公式实现了快速衍生品定价与校准，并能捕捉市场隐含波动率的关键经验特征。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a Volterra Stein-Stein model with stochastic interest rates, where volatility and rates are driven by correlated Gaussian Volterra processes, unifying various Markovian and non-Markovian models while providing explicit and semi-explicit pricing formulas that enable fast derivative pricing, calibration, and capture of key empirical implied volatility features.
